title: Chapter 649
text:
Section Zero's fleet was far away from the Bloodshed Land's stronghold. The shocking performance of Black Star in the battle earlier quickly spread throughout the entire fleet. The other teammates who were on the battlefield were all shocked, and only after watching the video did they dispel their doubts.

Han Xiao met up with Lagi and the others. The intensity of the battle was not high, and the casualties were very light, even smaller than the first battle.

After leaving the battlefield, a notification popped up on the interface.

You have received 1 Legendary Point.

Han Xiaoxin was not too surprised. In the past, before he reached Grade A, he had faced the attack of three Dark-star Calamity Grades and obtained the [Battle of the Three Calamity Grades] Legendary Point. Now that he was facing eight even more famous Vanguard Officials, obtaining a Legendary Point was within his expectations.

Star Cluster Legendary Point (Colton Star Cluster): Indestructible Body. You defeated the eight Vanguard Officials of the Bloodshed Land and used an impeccable battle record to prove that you are worthy of the nickname given to you. This battle will be passed down by word of mouth and become an everlasting legend!

"Indestructible Body …"

Han Xiao was shocked. This was originally just a nickname given to him by the various organizations, but now, it had become an official Legendary Point. He could not help but feel an inexplicable sense of excitement.

He had finally made a real name for himself!

The reward of increasing his Star Cluster Legendary Point by twenty percent was even higher than the Star System Legendary Point. This was his first Star Cluster Legendary Point.

"If I defeated the eight Vanguard Officials head-on, the influence will probably be a Star Field Legendary Point."

Han Xiao shook his head. This was beyond his capabilities. The Vanguard Officials were all muscular tyrants, and they were all very tanky. Furthermore, the eight of them worked together and controlled the rhythm of the battle. His current limit was to retreat safely. Only a Beyond Grade A would be able to easily deal with such a situation.

On the interface, the tactical mission was displayed as completed. Han Xiao was about to contact Ralph and ask him to fulfill the deal, but just as he took out his communicator, Ralph's communication request arrived first.

As soon as the communication was connected, Ralph immediately said, "Black Star, your combat strength exceeded my expectations. You really did it! Although we didn't win this time, you've stopped our decline … "

Ralph was not stingy with his praises. Because the members of Section Zero were afraid of the Bloodshed Land's killing tactics against high-level combatants, none of the Calamity Grade Supers were willing to participate in the battle. At this critical juncture, Han Xiao was the only one who could fight head-on and restrain the high-level combatants of the enemy. In Ralph's eyes, Han Xiao was like a lifesaver, and he could not stop praising him.

Han Xiao couldn't help but interrupt him.

"Stop for a moment. Let's not waste any more time. It's time to complete the deal. Give me the Cutting-Edge Knowledge. I want to leave the battlefield for a while."

There was a sense of déjà vu of "Give me the ball, I want to go home."

Hearing this, Ralph's excited expression froze on his face. He said in shock, "You want to withdraw from the secret war?"

"It's only temporary. As you can see, in order to block the eight Vanguard Officials, my Mech Legion was wiped out. I'm a Mechanic, and without machinery, my combat strength will decrease greatly. Furthermore, I've actually suffered very serious internal injuries. I can't even stand up now, and my limbs won't listen to me. I'm just holding myself back from vomiting blood."

Han Xiao's face was not red, and he was not panting at all.

"Really?" Ralph looked at Han Xiao suspiciously.

He didn't look like he was injured at all.

"Why? Do you want me to vomit blood for you to see?" Han Xiao opened his mouth and was about to vomit.

"Alright, alright, I believe you." Ralph hurriedly stopped him. He felt that Black Star might really have been seriously injured.

However, after thinking about it, he had faced the eight infamous Vanguard Officials head-on and even suffered a Beyond Grade A attack. It was normal for him to pay a price.

Han Xiao paused for a moment before explaining, "I need to rest for a while. Cutting-Edge Knowledge is extremely complicated. I'll need half a month … hmm, a month to learn it."

Ralph nodded. What Han Xiao said made sense. Cutting-Edge Knowledge was indeed very complicated.

"Furthermore, I also need time to rebuild the Mech Legion. This is a huge project. Otherwise, I won't be able to display my full strength. Even if I participate in the battle, it will be meaningless, right?"

"Er … I guess so."

Ralph was conflicted. "However, if you withdraw, we really won't have the ability to fight back at the high-level combatants level. You also know that the other members don't even put in any effort."

Han Xiao shrugged and acted as if he had done his best. He shook his head and said,

He shook his head and said, "As you can see, I can't change the situation alone. This battle has already proven that. Even if I stall the Vanguard Officials, the fleet still won't be able to break through the stronghold of Bloodshed Land. Compared to Bloodshed Land, our combined fleet is nothing. The way I see it, Bloodshed Land's invasion is a foregone conclusion. "

After the two battles, Ralph was also rather pessimistic. He could not help but ask, "What do you think?"

"I feel that at the beginning of the secret war, Bloodshed Land will gather their forces and build the first batch of strongholds. It will be very difficult for us to stop this from happening. However, if Bloodshed Land wants to invade the few Star Systems at the border, they will definitely split their forces and occupy more strongholds. This will cause their forces to be scattered, and Section Zero will have a chance to retaliate at that time."

Han Xiao's tone was honest. Although he did not understand the details of the version update, he remembered the situation at the later stages of the secret war in Version 3.0. From this, he could deduce the advantage that Bloodshed Land had in the early stages.

The advancement of Bloodshed Land could not be stopped. The reason he wanted to withdraw was because he did not want to look for trouble in the early stages.

Ralph pondered for a while and could only admit that Han Xiao's words made sense. The situation might really develop that way. He suddenly felt helpless and asked, "You're right. Do you have any practical suggestions?"

"I feel that the most important thing now is to do our internal work well and solve the problem of the high-level combatants of Section Zero avoiding the battle. Bloodshed Land should focus on building a bridgehead. We should not have any unrealistic fantasies of chasing all the enemies away. It's best to stop when the time is right to retaliate. What we need to do now is to bide our time … cough, what I mean is to conserve our energy. "

Star Cluster Civilizations did not lack resources. In order to defend against Bloodshed Land, the Amethyst Civilization could spend money to increase the strength of Section Zero. To Han Xiao, who had already displayed his value, if the Amethyst Civilization accepted his suggestion, he would be able to obtain even more benefits.

Putting aside the fact that Han Technician wanted to slack off, this suggestion actually made sense. At least in Ralph's opinion, this was a feasible strategy.

"I will pass your suggestion to the command center and let them analyze it." Ralph paused for a while before sighing. "As for your request for leave, I will approve it. I only have one request, which is to return to the battlefield as soon as possible after you've fully recovered."

"Of course. When will you give me the Cutting-Edge Knowledge?"

"I will send you a list of knowledge later. You can choose from it yourself. We will send it to you very soon. By the way, the resources to compensate for the losses will also be sent to you as soon as possible."

Hearing this, Han Xiao let out a lazy smile.

With the Cutting-Edge Knowledge in hand and the Class Advancement mission, he had completed one of his goals of participating in the secret war.

Han Xiao did not spend too much time gaining Favorability. His feat of stalling the eight Vanguard Officials could not be replicated. After this battle, the Vanguard Officials would realize that he was difficult to kill and would not waste their energy working together again. This time, he had gained fame, and the Vanguard Officials would definitely not make the same mistake again.

Although he was extremely tanky, his actual deterrence was not too high. As long as there were one or two Vanguard Officials, they would be able to restrain him. The situation today would not happen again.

In order to increase his deterrence, he would have to continue upgrading and build new machinery with Cutting-Edge Knowledge as the core.

After closing the communication, Ralph sent him the list of knowledge.

There were a total of sixty types of knowledge in the Mechanic class. There were twenty types in the Armed, Energy, and Control branches, and there were a total of five levels. There were forty-five types of knowledge in the Basic, Advanced, and Advanced levels. There were only fifteen types of knowledge in the final Cutting-Edge and Ultimate Knowledge.

There were a total of nine types of Cutting-Edge Knowledge, three in each branch. The Amethyst Civilization did not have all the Cutting-Edge Knowledge, only a portion of it.

Han Xiao was a Virtual Mechanic, so it was normal for him to spend Potential Points to learn the Control branch of Cutting-Edge Knowledge. However, learning the other two branches of Cutting-Edge Knowledge would require three times the amount.

However, Han Xiao did not choose the Control branch but chose the Energy branch of Cutting-Edge Knowledge.

[Abnormal State Energy]!

No matter what kind of Class Advancement a Mechanic was, this knowledge was compulsory. It could be said that it was the threshold of a Mechanic's sublimation.

Only after learning this knowledge would a Mechanic possess the technology to collect, refine, and use psionic energy and antimatter energy on a large scale!

Energy was the core of machinery. The revolution of energy technology would bring about a complete transformation!

Han Xiao had been waiting for this knowledge for a very long time. He had already saved up a new wave of Potential Points, and he could afford to spend three times the amount.

As he did not have to participate in the following battle, Han Xiao left with his troops and returned to the Garton Star System base.

Seeing that the Black Star Corps had left, the other members of Section Zero were envious, but no one had any objections.

Black Star had taken a huge risk in this battle and indeed had the right to return to rest. The others could only watch as the Black Star Corps left.

Thinking that they were going to be trampled on by Bloodshed Land again, only one song could express their feelings.

Come back quickly, we can't take it anymore …

…

The second battle between Purple Crystal and Klent came to an end. The other five Star Cluster Civilizations in the Shattered Star Ring, who were paying attention to the situation of the secret war, immediately received the battlefield report. The various high ranking officials could not believe their eyes.

Black Star fought against eight Vanguard Officials under the Tyrant alone, but he managed to escape unscathed in the end?

Is this a joke?

This information appeared on the table of the leaders of the various organizations at lightning speed, and it instantly caused a huge commotion in the circle of large organizations in the entire Star Field!

The seven Star Cluster Civilizations, including Bloodshed Land, and the various large organizations all had a new understanding of Han Xiao.

Originally, in their eyes, Black Star's biggest label was that he was Ames' trusted aide, and the second biggest label was that he had a strong network of connections. Black Star's position in the circle basically came from these two labels. In terms of combat strength, these organizations did not think highly of him because of this. Their evaluation of him was very pertinent. Black Star was a relatively powerful Calamity Grade Super and could hold his own. However, among those of the same grade, he was not overwhelmingly strong.

However, this piece of information completely shattered all the evaluations that these organizations had of Han Xiao.

Based on his performance in this battle, the seven Star Cluster Civilizations and the various large organizations made a new evaluation of his strength.

"In the universe, individualism is not prevalent. The strong usually have to face the encirclement of multiple opponents of the same grade, and the Supers who are best at fighting one against many are publicly recognized as Mages and Mechanics."

"Black Star is a Mechanic, but the way he fights one against many is completely different."

"The common problem of Mechanics is that their bodies are not strong enough. Other than a portion of Mechanics who specialize in individual combat, the weakness of most Mechanics is that they are afraid of sudden assaults. However, Black Star has an unbelievable physique with extremely high endurance. He also has an Esper recovery ability, which ensures his safety. Sudden assaults become a trap for him."

"He is an anomaly among Mechanics. Even if he loses his machinery, with this physique of his, he still has a considerable amount of combat power. Endurance is his advantage, and he is able to drag out more than ninety percent of the Calamity Grades to death. Note: This range covers the entire Star Field."

"From the mechanical abilities Black Star displayed, it can be clearly seen that he has yet to grasp how to use psionic energy. Once he starts using psionic energy as a source of energy, coupled with his terrifying physique, Black Star's threat will increase exponentially. He will undoubtedly become a small group of people standing at the peak of the Calamity Grade."

"Based on the above information, it is strongly recommended that he be moved into the [Shattered Star Ring Beyond Grade A Seed Observation List] …"

"Black Star has the potential to become a Beyond Grade A!"

The Beyond Grade A Seed Observation List was a whole new level, beyond the scope of ordinary Calamity Grades. The people on this list were all people that the Star Cluster Civilizations paid attention to. Every name represented a prodigy with the potential to become a Beyond Grade A Super.

The basis of judgment was not only potential but also potential, strength, growth speed, special talents, species, ability type, and other factors.

The selection range was the entire Shattered Star Ring, and the population was at the level of a capital city.

However …
